title: BPW-2026-0561
text:
[BUREAU OF ENGINEERING]
BPW-2026-0561
CD 14
TERMINATE CONSTRUCTION CONTRACT AND ISSUE CHANGE ORDER NOS. 8 AND 9 – ACCESS PACIFIC, INC. (API)
Recommending the Board:
APPROVE termination, without prejudice, of the City of Los Angeles Contract with API;
AUTHORIZE the City Engineer to issue Change Order No. 8 to API in the amount of $623,154.16, for the Broadway Historic Theater District Pedestrian Improvements 4th Street to 6th Street Project to settle all claims and costs associated with the termination of this construction Contract;
AUTHORIZE the City Engineer to issue Supplemental Agreement Final Close-Out Change Order No. 9 in the deductive net amount of $8,487,647.44, for the project to delete all unused bid items and their respective quantities in the Contract and additive costs associated with storage fees for purchased materials; and
APPROVE the use of Funding Table No. 2 which lists new funding sources as amended in this report, in lieu of the previously approved funding table from Joint Report No. 1, adopted March 29, 2023.
(W.O.: E1907979, C-143530)
summary: The board would terminate the city's construction contract with Access Pacific, Inc. for pedestrian improvements on Broadway between 4th and 6th streets. It would also approve a settlement change order and a final close-out change order that deletes unused work.

details.amount: $623,154.16 (Change Order No. 8); $8,487,647.44 deductive net (Change Order No. 9)
details.action: Terminate construction contract and issue change orders 8 and 9
